enDef: the part that sticks out at the back of an animal’s body, and that it can move

example.en: The dog wagged its tail .
example.cn: 那条狗摇了摇尾巴。

example.en: I like these and he likes those.
example.cn: 我喜欢这些，他喜欢那些。

enDef: the day between Monday and Wednesday

example.en: I’ll see you Tuesday.
example.cn: 星期二见。

enDef: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water onto leaves or flowers, sometimes used as a medicine

example.en: ...a cup of tea.
example.cn: …一杯茶。

enDef: the number 10

example.en: Snow had been falling steadily for ten days.
example.cn: 雪已经连续下了10天了。

enDef: a piece of furniture with a flat top supported by legs

example.en: The food was served on long tables.
example.cn: 食物放在长餐桌上供应。

enDef: if a plane taxis, it moves along the ground before taking off or after landing

example.en: The plane taxied to a halt.
example.cn: 飞机滑行一段距离后停下来。

cn: 转动， 旋转； 扭转， 转向； 变化， 变成
enDef: to move your body so that you are looking in a different direction

example.en: Ricky turned and walked away.
example.cn: 里基转身走了。

enDef: used before two  comparative  adjectives or adverbs to show that the degree of one event or situation is related to the degree of another one

example.en: What should I do with the token?
example.cn: 我该怎么用这个辅币呢？

cn: [threw-thrown] 投， 扔， 抛； 使突然陷入； 使困惑， 使吃惊
enDef: to make an object such as a ball move quickly through the air by pushing your hand forward quickly and letting the object go

example.en: The bus stopped suddenly and we were all thrown forwards.
example.cn: 公共汽车猛地停住，我们都往前栽。

enDef: to tell someone that you are pleased and grateful for something they have done, or to be polite about it

example.en: I haven’t had a chance to thank him yet.
example.cn: 我还没有机会向他表示谢意。

enDef: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with people that have already been mentioned

example.en: When our washing machine broke, our neighbours let us use theirs.
example.cn: 我们的洗衣机坏了的时候，邻居就让我们用他们的。

cn: [tying]　拴， 扎， 捆； 把…打结， 系上； 连接， 使有关联； 不分胜负
enDef: to get married

example.en: He tied the ends of the plastic bag together.
example.cn: 他把塑料袋的两头系在一起。

cn: 高的；长的；过分的；夸大的
enDef: a person, building, tree etc that is tall is a greater height than normal

example.en: He was young and tall.
example.cn: 他年轻，身材高大。

cn: 烘， 烤； 敬酒， 为…干杯
enDef: to drink a glass of wine etc to thank some-one, wish someone luck, or celebrate something

example.en: I toasted the cheese sandwiches.
example.cn: 我烤了干酪三明治。

enDef: to keep and care for something that is very special, important, or valuable to you

example.en: Jim treasured the gold pocket watch that his grandfather had given him.
example.cn: 吉姆十分珍爱祖父送给他的金怀表。

cn: 票， 入场券， 车票； 罚款传票； 候选
enDef: a printed piece of paper which shows that you have paid to enter a cinema, travel on a bus, plane etc

example.en: He ran for governor on the Republican ticket.
example.cn: 他作为共和党的候选人竞选州长。

cn: 在那里， 往那里； 在那方面， 在那点上
enDef: in or to a particular place that is not where you are

example.en: We could go back to my cottage and have lunch there.
example.cn: 我们可以回到我的小屋去吃午饭。

enDef: A ton is a unit of weight that is equal to 2,240 pounds

example.en: Hundreds of tons of oil spilled into the ocean.
example.cn: 数百吨石油溢出流入大海。

cn: 顶， 顶端； 上部， 上端； 首位， 最高位
enDef: the highest part of something

example.en: a low wooden table with a glass top
example.cn: 玻璃桌面的矮木桌

cn: 也， 还； 太， 过于； 很， 非常
enDef: more than is acceptable or possible

example.en: Do you think the music’s too loud?
example.cn: 你觉得音乐太响了吗？

enDef: used to refer to two or more people or things that have already been mentioned or are already known about

example.en: Bob and Sue said they wouldn’t be able to come.
example.cn: 鲍勃和休说他们来不了。

cn: 漫不经心地考虑； 摆弄
enDef: an object for children to play with

example.en: some toys for the baby
example.cn: 宝宝玩的一些玩具

cn: 最拥挤部分；活动最多部分；事物的粗大浓密部分
enDef: if something is thick, there is a large distance or a larger distance than usual between its two opposite surfaces or sides

example.en: Brown hopes to be back in the thick of the action as soon as possible.
example.cn: 布朗希望尽快回去，参与到最紧要的行动中。

enDef: someone who is visiting a place for pleasure on holiday

example.en: Cambridge is always full of tourists in the summer.
example.cn: 剑桥在夏季总是挤满了游客。

enDef: the number 1,000

example.en: a journey of almost a thousand miles
example.cn: 将近1,000英里的旅程

enDef: into one side or end of an entrance, passage, hole etc and out of the other side or end

example.en: She smiled at him as he walked through the door.
example.cn: 他从门口进来时，她朝他笑了。

enDef: during the night of this day

example.en: I think I’ll go to bed early tonight.
example.cn: 我想今晚我会早点上床睡觉。

enDef: to say things to someone as part of a conversation

example.en: I could hear Sarah and Andy talking in the next room.
example.cn: 我听到萨拉和安迪在隔壁讲话。

enDef: a tall narrow building either built on its own or forming part of a castle, church etc

example.en: the Eiffel Tower
example.cn: 埃菲尔铁塔

enDef: the vehicles moving along a road or street

example.en: The traffic accident had nothing to do with him.
example.cn: 这交通事故和他一点关系也没有。

enDef: to teach someone as a tutor

example.en: He was privately tutored.
example.cn: 他是由家庭教师教的。

cn: 口渴的； 渴望的， 渴求的
enDef: feeling that you want or need a drink

example.en: Can I have a glass of water? I’m really thirsty.
example.cn: 我能喝一杯水吗？ 我太渴了。

cn: 试图， 努力； 试验， 试用； 审讯， 审理； 考验， 磨炼
enDef: to take action in order to do something that you may not be able to do

example.en: Let’s have a rest and then we’ll try again.
example.cn: 我们休息一下，然后再试。

enDef: someone whose job is to teach, especially in a school

example.en: a primary school teacher
example.cn: 小学教师

example.en: He came in twentieth.
example.cn: 他得了第二十名。

enDef: a large area with houses, shops, offices etc where people live and work, that is smaller than a city and larger than a village

example.en: an industrial town in the Midlands
example.cn: 英格兰中部的一座工业城镇

cn: 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
enDef: the thing that is measured in minutes, hours, days, years etc using clocks

example.en: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
example.cn: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

enDef: a room, house, desk etc that is tidy is neatly arranged with everything in the right place

example.en: a tidy desk
example.cn: 整洁的书桌

enDef: the number 30

example.en: In the thirties, air travel really began to take off.
example.cn: 在30年代，乘飞机旅行迅速流行了起来。

enDef: the number 2

example.en: I’ll be away for almost two weeks.
example.cn: 我要离开差不多两周时间。

enDef: the soft part inside your mouth that you can move about and use for eating and speaking

example.en: Joe ran his tongue over his dry lips.
example.cn: 乔舔了舔干燥的嘴唇。

enDef: to have a particular opinion or to believe that something is true

example.en: I thought I heard something.
example.cn: 我觉得我听到了什么声音。

enDef: a group of people who play a game or sport together against another group

example.en: Which team do you support?
example.cn: 你支持哪个队？

cn: 惨事， 灾难； 悲剧
enDef: a very sad event, that shocks people because it involves death

example.en: The tragedy happened as they were returning home from a night out.
example.cn: 悲剧发生在他们夜里外出归来的路上。

cn: 事， 事情， 事件； 物， 东西； 局面， 情况， 事态； 所有物， 用品
enDef: an object that you are talking about without saying its name, or whose name you do not know

example.en: What’s that red thing?
example.cn: 那个红色的东西是什么？

enDef: until

example.en: I didn’t have a boyfriend till I was 17.
example.cn: 我直到17岁才有男朋友。

enDef: feeling that you want to sleep or rest

example.en: He looks tired out (= very tired ) .
example.cn: 他看起来累坏了。

enDef: a strong belief in the honesty, goodness etc of someone or something

example.en: At first there was a lack of trust between them.
example.cn: 起初，他们之间缺乏信任。

enDef: a thick substance that you use to clean your teeth

example.en: Shaving supplies, toothpaste, and soap were found inside.
example.cn: 在里面找到了剃须用品、牙膏和肥皂。

enDef: relating to teenagers or used by teenagers

example.en: a rock star and teen idol
example.cn: 一位摇滚歌星兼青春偶像

enDef: the number 3

example.en: They’ve won their last three games.
example.cn: 他们赢了最近三场比赛。

enDef: complete, or as great as is possible

example.en: a total ban on cigarette advertising
example.cn: 香烟广告的全面禁止

enDef: extremely small

example.en: a tiny community in the Midwest
example.cn: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

cn: 主题， 题目； 【音】主旋律
enDef: the main subject or idea in a piece of writing, speech, film etc

example.en: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
example.cn: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

enDef: a game for two people or two pairs of people who use  rackets  to hit a small soft ball backwards and forwards over a net

example.en: She excels all of us at tennis.
example.cn: 她的网球比我们打得都好。

cn: 旅行； 行进； 被传送， 被传播； 走过， 驶过
enDef: to move at a particular speed or in a particular direction

example.en: Light travels faster than sound.
example.cn: 光比声音传播得快。

enDef: a very tall plant that has branches and leaves, and lives for many years

example.en: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
example.cn: 小时候，我喜欢爬树。

cn: [told-told] 讲， 告诉； 吩咐， 命令； 说明， 显示； 分辨， 区分
enDef: if someone tells you something, they communicate information, a story, their feelings etc to you

example.en: I’ll tell you all about it when I get back.
example.cn: 我回来再告诉你这一切。

enDef: two times

example.en: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
example.cn: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

example.en: They have their compensations.
example.cn: 他们有他们的报酬。

enDef: the number 13

example.en: They’ve only sold thirteen tickets so far.
example.cn: 到目前为止他们仅仅售出13张票。

enDef: if two things touch, or one thing touches another thing, they reach each other so that there is no space between them

example.en: As our glasses touched, he said ‘Cheers!’
example.cn: 我们的酒杯相碰时，他说了声:“干杯！”

enDef: one of three equal parts of something

example.en: Divide it into thirds.
example.cn: 把它分成三等份。

enDef: a visit to a place that involves a journey, for pleasure or a particular purpose

example.en: Two lucky employees won a round-the-world trip.
example.cn: 两名幸运的雇员赢得一次环游世界的机会。

enDef: new machines, equipment, and ways of doing things that are based on modern knowledge about science and computers

example.en: Modern technology makes moving money around much easier than it used to be.
example.cn: 现代科技使货币流动比以前便捷得多。

cn: 治疗， 疗法； 对待， 待遇； 处理
enDef: something that is done to cure someone who is injured or ill

example.en: Just lately, Kyra has been giving me the silent treatment (= refusing to speak to me because she is angry with me ) .
example.cn: 就在最近，凯拉一直对我不理不睬。

enDef: a shelter consisting of a sheet of cloth supported by poles and ropes, used especially for camping

example.en: We looked for a flat spot where we could pitch our tent (= put up our tent ) .
example.cn: 我们寻找一个平缓的地方搭帐篷。

cn: 措词，术语；期限，任期；学期；
enDef: a word or expression with a particular meaning, especially one that is used for a specific subject or type of language

example.en: Teachers often feel overworked in term time (= during the term ) .
example.cn: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

enDef: a story about exciting imaginary events

example.en: a book of old Japanese folk tales
example.cn: 日本古老民间故事书

cn: 第十二的，第十二个的；十二分之一的

example.en: He poled his twelfth home run in the sixth inning.
example.cn: 在第六回合他打出了他的第十二次本垒打。

enDef: to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills

example.en: a highly trained workforce
example.cn: 训练有素的劳动力

cn: 试验， 测试； 检验
enDef: a set of questions, exercises, or practical activities to measure someone’s skill, ability, or knowledge

example.en: Did you get a good mark in the test?
example.cn: 你这次测验成绩好吗？

cn: [took-taken] 带， 携带； 需要， 花费； 拿， 取得； 接受； 吃， 喝， 服(药
enDef: to move or go with someone or something from one place to another

example.en: Would you mind taking Susie home ?
example.cn: 请你带苏茜回家好吗？

cn: 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动
enDef: to change written or spoken words into another language

example.en: Poetry doesn’t usually translate well.
example.cn: 诗歌通常都译不好。

example.en: At that moment, the thirteenth fairy arrived.
example.cn: 就在这时，第十三位仙女出现了。

cn: 系， 捆； 把…录在磁带上
enDef: If you tape music, sounds, or television pictures, you record them using a tape recorder or a video recorder

example.en: She has just taped an interview.
example.cn: 她刚刚录制了一次采访。

enDef: someone who steals things from another person or place

example.en: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
example.cn: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。

cn: 在一起， 共同； 一致地， 协调地
enDef: if two or more people do something together, they do it with each other

example.en: We’ve very much enjoyed working together .
example.cn: 我们在一起工作非常开心。

enDef: the number 20

example.en: a small village twenty miles from Nairobi
example.cn: 距内罗毕20英里的一个小村庄

cn: 然后；那么；于是；当时；此外
enDef: at a particular time in the past or future

example.en: I wish I had known then what I know now.
example.cn: 我真希望那时我就知道现在所知道的一切。

cn: 兴奋， 激动； 引起激动的事物； 震动， 颤抖
enDef: a sudden strong feeling of excitement and pleasure, or the thing that makes you feel this

example.en: Winning first place must have been quite a thrill.
example.cn: 赢得第一名肯定让人非常激动。

enDef: being part of the traditions of a country or group of people

example.en: traditional Italian cooking
example.cn: 传统的意大利烹饪

cn: 极度的， 厉害的； 可怕的， 骇人的； 很糟的， 极坏的
enDef: very bad

example.en: The hotel was absolutely terrible.
example.cn: 这家宾馆糟糕透了。

enDef: a  reptile  that lives mainly in water and has a soft body covered by a hard shell

example.en: ...a pet turtle.
example.cn: …一只宠物龟。

enDef: a textbook

example.en: a chemistry text
example.cn: 化学课本

cn: 垃圾， 废物； 拙劣的文学作品； 没用
enDef: things that you throw away, such as empty bottles, used papers, food that has gone bad etc

example.en: Will someone take out the trash (= take it outside the house ) ?
example.cn: 谁把垃圾拿出去好吗？

cn: 任务， 工作； 作业
enDef: a piece of work that must be done, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant or that must be done regularly

example.en: Sara had the task of preparing the agenda for meetings.
example.cn: 萨拉的任务是准备会议议程。

cn: 比（用于形容词、副词的比较级之后）；除…外（用于other等之后）；与其…（用于 rather等之后）；一…就（用于 no sooner等之后）
enDef: used when comparing two things, people, situations etc

example.en: Natalie was prettier than her sister.
example.cn: 纳塔莉比她姐姐漂亮。

cn: 真实的， 确实的； 真正的， 真的； 忠诚的， 忠实的； 准确的， 精确的
enDef: based on facts and not imagined or invented

example.en: No, honestly, it’s a true story .
example.cn: 不，真的，这是一个真实的故事。

cn: 戏院， 剧场； 影剧院
enDef: a building or place with a stage where plays and shows are performed

example.en: an open-air theatre (= a theatre that is outside )
example.cn: 露天剧场

enDef: a large wild animal that has yellow and black lines on its body and is a member of the cat family

example.en: He came at me like a tiger.
example.cn: 他像老虎一般地向我冲过来。

cn: 温度； 体温； 热度， 发烧
enDef: a measure of how hot or cold a place or thing is

example.en: The temperature of the water was just right for swimming.
example.cn: 这水温游泳正好。

enDef: a room or building containing a toilet

example.en: public toilets
example.cn: 公共厕所

cn: 可是， 不过， 然而
enDef: used after adding a fact, opinion, or question which seems surprising after what you have just said, or which makes what you have just said seem less true

example.en: Two heart attacks in a year. It hasn’t stopped him smoking, though.
example.cn: 一年里心脏病发作了两次，可是那也没让他把烟戒掉。

cn: 运输， 运输系统； 运输工具
enDef: a system or method for carrying passengers or goods from one place to another

example.en: The city needs to improve its public transportation (= buses, trains etc ) .
example.cn: 这座城市需要改善公共交通。

cn: 对待，处理；治疗，医治；款待，招待
enDef: to behave towards someone or something in a particular way

example.en: It was difficult to treat patients because of a shortage of medicine.
example.cn: 由于缺少药物，很难给病人治病。

enDef: used to refer to two or more people or things that have already been mentioned or are already known about

example.en: Has anyone seen my keys? I can’t find them anywhere.
example.cn: 有人见到我的钥匙吗？我哪儿都找不到。

enDef: the number 12

example.en: He received a twelve-month jail sentence.
example.cn: 他获刑12个月。

cn: 他们自己； 他们亲自
enDef: used to show that the people who do something are affected by their own action

example.en: Teachers have no choice but to take measures to protect themselves.
example.cn: 教师们别无选择，只能采取措施来保护自己。

enDef: used to describe one of two children who are twins

example.en: the twin problems of poverty and unemployment
example.cn: 贫穷和失业这对孪生问题

enDef: a piece of cloth that you use for drying your skin or for drying things such as dishes

example.en: Have you got a clean towel I could use?
example.cn: 你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

cn: 向， 朝， 面对； 接近

enDef: something that you think of, remember, or realize

example.en: It’s an interesting thought.
example.cn: 这想法很有趣。

enDef: a pain in a tooth

example.en: I’ve got toothache .
example.cn: 我牙痛。

cn: 戏院， 剧场； 影剧院

enDef: used to say how big, how much etc, when you are showing the size, amount etc with your hands

example.en: The table’s about this high and this wide.
example.cn: 那桌子大约有这么高，这么宽。

enDef: the day after today

example.en: I’ll see you at tomorrow’s meeting.
example.cn: 明天会上见。

enDef: a small brush that you use for cleaning your teeth

example.en: How do you choose your toothbrush?
example.cn: 你是如何选择你的牙刷的？

enDef: someone who uses violence such as bombing, shooting etc to obtain political demands

example.en: We refuse to talk to terrorists.
example.cn: 我们拒绝和恐怖分子对话。

enDef: problems or difficulties

example.en: Recent stock market losses point to trouble ahead.
example.cn: 最近股市的下跌预示着未来将有麻烦。

enDef: to buy and sell goods, services etc as your job or business

example.en: They had to travel into town to trade the produce from their farm.
example.cn: 他们不得不到镇上去出售他们农场的产品。

enDef: the passage from the back of your mouth to the top of the tubes that go down to your lungs and stomach

example.en: The singer complained of a sore throat after Wednesday’s show.
example.cn: 星期三演出后，这位歌手说喉咙痛。

example.en: One second of arc movement is one thirtieth of a millimetre.
example.cn: 一弧秒的移动是一毫米的三十分之一。

enDef: a round soft red fruit eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable

example.en: He staked his tomato vines with bamboo.
example.cn: 他用竹竿支撑起西红柿秧。

enDef: as a result of something that has just been mentioned

example.en: Their car was bigger and therefore more comfortable.
example.cn: 他们的车大些，所以更舒适些。

example.en: He dotted down those notes.
example.cn: 他匆匆记下了那些注解。

cn: 事实， 真相； 真实性； 真理
enDef: the true facts about something, rather than what is untrue, imagined, or guessed

example.en: How do we know you’re telling us the truth?
example.cn: 我们怎么知道你告诉我们的是真话？

enDef: the system of communication that you use to have a conversation with someone in another place

example.en: The telephone rang just as I was leaving.
example.cn: 我正要走，电话铃响了。

enDef: a piece of electronic equipment shaped like a box with a screen, on which you can watch programmes

example.en: Lucy turned on the television to watch the evening news.
example.cn: 露西打开电视收看晚间新闻。

cn: 工具， 用具； 方法， 手段
enDef: something that you hold in your hand and use to do a particular job

example.cn: 艾伦抓住缰绳，小马开始慢跑起来。

enDef: to pull a vehicle or ship along behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain

example.en: The ship had to be towed into the harbor.
example.cn: 那艘轮船不得不被拖进港口。

cn: 把边塞到下面；把…夹入，把…藏入
enDef: to put something into a small space, especially in order to protect, hide, carry, or hold it

example.en: He tried to tuck his flapping shirt inside his trousers.
example.cn: 他试图把飘动的衬衫塞进他的裤子里。

cn: 营业额， 成交量； 人员调整， 人员更替率
enDef: the amount of business done during a particular period

example.en: The company had a turnover of $3.8 million.
example.cn: 那个公司拥有380万美元的营业额。

enDef: if you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun

example.en: She has a pale skin which doesn’t tan easily.
example.cn: 她的肤色很白，不容易被晒黑。

cn: 艰难地进行， 费力地做
enDef: hard unpleasant work done over a long period

example.en: a life of toil
example.cn: 辛劳的一生

example.en: You have probably heard of this tactic before.
example.cn: 你以前也可能听说过这个策略。

enDef: a state of confusion, excitement, or anxiety

example.en: She lived through the turmoil of the French Revolution.
example.cn: 她经历过法国大革命的混乱之后仍旧活着。

cn: 节俭；节约；[植] 海石竹
enDef: wise and careful use of money, so that none is wasted

example.en: They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.
example.cn: 他们因勤俭节约和开创精神而受到了应得的表扬。

enDef: the crime of being disloyal to your country or its government, especially by helping its enemies or trying to remove the government using violence

example.en: The defendant was convicted of high treason (= treason of the worst kind ) and sentenced to death.
example.cn: 被告被判犯有严重叛国罪，并处以死刑。

cn: 奔流；倾注；迸发；连续不断
enDef: A torrent is a lot of water falling or flowing rapidly or violently

example.en: Torrents of water gushed into the reservoir.
example.cn: 急流涌进了水库。

cn: 禁忌， 忌讳；禁止 A
enDef: a custom that says you must avoid a particular activity or subject, either because it is considered offensive or because your religion does not allow it

example.en: The topic of addiction remains something of a taboo in our family.
example.cn: 毒瘾在我们家依然是个有些忌讳的话题。

cn: 手推车， 小车；〈英〉无轨电车； 〈美〉有轨电车

enDef: if a star or light twinkles, it shines in the dark with an unsteady light

example.en: stars twinkling in the sky
example.cn: 天空中闪烁的星星

cn: 叛徒；卖国贼；背信弃义的人
enDef: someone who is not loyal to their country, friends, or beliefs

example.en: Some say he's a traitor to the peace movement.
example.cn: 一些人说他是和平运动的背叛者。

enDef: a mass of diseased cells in your body that have divided and increased too quickly

example.en: a brain tumour
example.cn: 脑瘤

enDef: a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university

example.en: the tutorial system
example.cn: 导师制

enDef: two times as much or as many of something

example.en: a twofold increase in cases of TB
example.cn: 结核病例两倍的增加

enDef: If someone taunts you, they say unkind or insulting things to you, especially about your weaknesses or failures

example.en: A gang taunted a disabled man.
example.cn: 一帮混混儿羞辱了一个残疾人。

enDef: tacit agreement, approval, support etc is given without anything actually being said

example.en: a tacit agreement between the three big companies
example.cn: 三家大公司之间的默契

enDef: an instrument used for keeping a room or a machine at a particular temperature

example.en: Turn off your thermostat when you’re not home.
example.cn: 当你不在家的时候关掉恒温器。

enDef: a book in which words are put into groups with other words that have similar meanings

example.en: I shall not be at peace,' moaned Catherine, recalled to a sense of physical weakness by the violent, unequal throbbing of her heart, which beat visibly and audibly under this excess of agitation.
example.cn: “我不会得到安息的，”凯瑟琳哀哭着，感到她身体的衰弱，因为在这场过度的激动下，她的心猛烈地、不规则地跳动着，甚至跳得能觉察出来。

enDef: a large group of people in one place

example.en: She got lost in the throng.
example.cn: 她在人群中迷路了。

enDef: not trans-parent, but clear enough to allow light to pass through

example.en: Blue veins showed through her translucent skin.
example.cn: 她半透明的皮肤下青筋显现。

enDef: an unpleasant and upsetting experience that affects you for a long time

example.en: traumas such as death or divorce
example.cn: 死亡、离婚等的巨大痛苦

enDef: a serious book or article about a particular subject

example.en: ...Locke's Treatise on Civil Government.
example.cn: ...洛克的《政府论》。

example.en: But the KGB, in turn, was deceiving the Englishmen, because it really believed that they were playing a treble game and were all traitors to the Communist cause.
example.cn: 但是克格勃实际上以欺骗回报了英国人，因为他们认为，这几个人在玩三重游戏，实际上是共产主义事业的叛徒。

enDef: to make a long and difficult journey, especially on foot

example.en: ...trekking through the jungles.
example.cn: …徒步穿越丛林。

example.en: Stephen Leckar has 30 minutes to represent Jones, and he tries to advance a second argument in this case: The very act of installing the GPS device on a private vehicle constitutes a trespass.
example.cn: 琼斯的律师斯蒂文·莱卡有30分钟时间替琼斯辩护，他又提出了一个新论点：警方在琼斯私人汽车上装跟踪器的做法本身构成“非法入侵”。

enDef: a stream or river that flows into a larger river

example.en: ...the Napo river, a tributary of the Amazon.
example.cn: ...纳波河，亚马孙河的一条支流。

enDef: if liquid trickles somewhere, it flows slowly in drops or in a thin stream

example.en: The water in the stream had been reduced to a trickle.
example.cn: 小溪里的水已只剩下一股细流。

cn: 适宜耕种的， 可耕种的
多刺的； 痛苦的， 棘手的
enDef: a question etc that is complicated and difficult

example.en: the thorny question of immigration policy
example.cn: 移民政策这个棘手的问题

cn: 册， 大部头书； 巨著
enDef: a large heavy book

example.en: Meantime, continuation of low tropospheric jet produces plentiful vapor for formation and continuation of rain gush.
example.cn: 同时，低空西南急流的维持，为暴雨的产生和维持提供了充足的水汽。

enDef: a short bar hanging from two ropes high above the ground, used by  acrobats

cn: 抄写， 誊写； 抄本， 誊本； 书面标注的事物； 改编
enDef: Transcription of speech or text is the process of transcribing it

example.en: Pronunciation is shown by a system of phonetic transcription.
example.cn: 发音通过一种音标系统标示出来。

cn: 抄写， 誊写； 打印； 转录
enDef: to write an exact copy of something

example.en: He had been asked to transcribe an ancient manuscript.
example.cn: 他被要求抄写一本古代手稿。

enDef: a poisonous substance, especially one that is produced by  bacteria  and causes a particular disease

example.en: Tests showed increased levels of toxin in shellfish.
example.cn: 测试表明贝类中的毒素级别上升了。

cn: 改变； 变化， 变形， 变质
enDef: to change one substance or type of thing into another

example.en: She ceased to think, as anger transmuted into passion.
example.cn: 随着愤慨变为激怒，她停止了思考。

example.en: Don't tamper with my business.
example.cn: 别干预我的事。

cn: 可触知的；明确的；确实的
enDef: clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen or noticed

example.en: The scheme must have tangible benefits for the unemployed.
example.cn: 这个计划一定要对失业者有实实在在的好处。

cn: (尤指金属表面)失去光泽；玷污
enDef: if an event or fact tarnishes someone’s  reputation  , record, image etc, it makes it worse

example.en: His regime was tarnished by human rights abuses.
example.cn: 他的政权因践踏人权而形象受损。

enDef: the system of charging taxes

example.en: the government’s economic and taxation policy
example.cn: 政府的经济和税收政策

example.en: They mocked at my timidity.
example.cn: 他们耻笑我胆小。

cn: (较淡)着色于，染色；使带有气息
enDef: to give something a small amount of a particular colour, emotion, or quality

example.en: Pink tinged her cheeks.
example.cn: 她面色粉红。

enDef: a group of singers, actors, dancers etc who work together

example.en: ...troupes of travelling actors.
example.cn: …巡回演出的演员剧团。

enDef: a student who stays away from school without permission

example.en: persistent truants
example.cn: 老是逃学的学生

enDef: an agreement between enemies to stop fighting or arguing for a short time, or the period for which this is arranged

example.en: They agreed to call a truce .
example.cn: 他们同意宣布休战。

enDef: able to be trusted and depended on

example.en: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
example.cn: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

enDef: a confused, noisy, and excited situation, often caused by a large crowd

example.en: I could simply not be heard in the tumult.
example.cn: 一片嘈杂声中别人根本听不到我说话。

cn: 小装饰品； 不值钱的珠宝

example.en: Heathcliff had opened the trinket and cast out its contents, replacing them by a black lock of his own.
example.cn: 希刺克厉夫把这小装饰品打开了，把里面的东西扔出来，装进他自己的一绺黑发。

cn: 踏车； 累人的活； 单调的例行工作， 乏味繁重的工作
enDef: work or a way of life that seems very boring because you always have to do the same things

example.en: the treadmill of working in the office
example.cn: 单调枯燥的办公室工作

cn: 可触摸地； 可感知地； 有形地

enDef: the telegraphic or telephonic communication of audio, video, or digital information over a distance by means of radio waves, optical signals, etc, or along a transmission line

example.en: If large media and telecommunication companies decide to close their offerings to the web, I am convinced the web will route around it.
example.cn: 如果大型媒体和电信公司决定停止向万维网提供内容，我很确信万维网会绕过这一点。

enDef: having a great or important effect

example.en: a telling argument
example.cn: 有说服力的论点

cn: 有节制的，不过分的；(气候)温和的
enDef: behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible

example.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
example.cn: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

cn: 可防守的，守得住的；可保持的，可维持的

example.en: an idea which is no longer tenable
example.cn: 不再成立的观点

enDef: determined to do something and unwilling to stop trying even when the situation becomes difficult

example.en: a tenacious negotiator
example.cn: 锲而不舍的谈判者

enDef: the period of time that someone rents a house, land etc

example.en: a six-month tenancy
example.cn: 六个月的租赁期

enDef: one of the long thin parts of a sea creature such as an  octopus  which it uses for holding things

example.en: Free speech is being gradually eroded year after year by new tentacles of government control.
example.cn: 言论自由正被政府控制的新触角逐渐侵蚀。

enDef: if a small child toddles, it walks with short, unsteady steps

example.en: ...once your baby starts toddling.
example.cn: ...一旦你的小孩开始蹒跚学步。

cn: 可忍受的，可容许的，尚好的
enDef: a situation that is tolerable is not very good, but you are able to accept it

example.en: The apartment is really too small, but it’s tolerable for the time being.
example.cn: 这套公寓实在太小，不过暂时还能凑合。

enDef: a toneless voice does not express any feelings

example.en: ‘I’m sorry,’ he said, in a flat toneless voice.
example.cn: “对不起。”他以淡淡的声调说道。

cn: 滋补品，补药；强身的，健体的
enDef: a drink that you have as a medicine to give you more energy or strength when you feel tired

example.en: A lot of people need a tonic at the end of the winter.
example.cn: 很多人冬末需要进补。

enDef: an extremely violent storm consisting of air that spins very quickly and causes a lot of damage

example.en: The tornado rubbished the whole village.
example.cn: 龙卷风毁掉了整个村庄。

enDef: easily becoming offended or annoyed

example.en: She is very touchy about her past.
example.cn: 她对自己的过去非常敏感。

enDef: a surface that consists of soil with grass on top, or an artificial surface that looks like this

example.en: soft green turf
example.cn: 柔软的绿色草皮

enDef: a small tool that has two narrow pieces of metal joined at one end, used to pull or move very small objects

example.en: She was plucking her eyebrows with a pair of tweezers .
example.cn: 她正拿着一把小镊子在拔眉毛。

enDef: a small very thin stem of wood that grows from a branch on a tree

example.en: There is the bird, sitting on a twig halfway up the tree.
example.cn: 鸟儿在那里，栖息在树中段的一根细枝上。

enDef: behaving in a cruel and unfair way towards someone you have power over

example.en: a tyrannical parent
example.cn: 一位专横的家长

cn: 使显得不重要， 轻视， 淡化
enDef: to make something seem less important or serious than it really is – used to show disapproval

example.en: The article trivializes the whole issue of equal rights.
example.cn: 文章对平等权利这个大问题轻描淡写。

cn: 倒塌， 倒下； 打倒， 推翻
enDef: to become unsteady and then fall over, or to make something do this

example.en: This scandal could topple the government.
example.cn: 这一丑闻可能使政府倒台。

enDef: the way a town or large parts of a town look

example.en: industrial townscapes
example.cn: 工业化的城市面貌

enDef: turbid water or liquid is dirty and muddy

example.en: A fisherman drags nets of oysters from the turbid river water on a breathless summer day.
example.cn: 一个渔民在喘不过气来的夏天从浑浊的河水里拖上了几网牡蛎。

cn: 部落的， 部族的； 集团意识强的
enDef: relating to a tribe or tribes

example.en: a tribal dance
example.cn: 部落舞蹈

enDef: a small tower on a large building, especially a  castle

example.en: Drop a grenade when a turret opens, but beware of bullets being fired at you.
example.cn: 当角楼打开的时候，扔出手榴弹，一定要注意躲避射向你的子弹。

enDef: relating to the Earth rather than to the moon or other  planets

example.en: ...terrestrial life forms.
example.cn: …地球上的生命形态。

enDef: related to land that is owned or controlled by a particular country

example.en: a territorial dispute
example.cn: 领土争端

example.en: Derek’s terse reply ended the conversation.
example.cn: 德里克的简短回答结束了谈话。

enDef: if ice or snow thaws, or if the sun thaws it, it turns into water

example.en: The lake thawed in March.
example.cn: 3月里，湖水解冻了。

enDef: the process of treating a broken bone with special medical equipment that pulls it

example.en: This process gives your vehicle the best chance of holding traction on the steep hill, because both the gearbox and the brakes are locking you in place.
example.cn: 以上一系列操作会让你的车子尽可能在陡坡上保持住牵引力，因为此时变速箱和制动器都起到了锁定车辆的作用。

enDef: a written or printed copy of a speech, conversation etc

example.en: There are no rules about when to transfuse and who to do it to.
example.cn: 从来没有相关规定，在什么时候什么人应该被输血。

cn: 越越限度；违反(法律规则)
enDef: to do something that is against the rules of social behaviour or against a moral principle

example.en: Orton’s plays transgress accepted social norms.
example.cn: 奥顿的戏剧违背了公认的社会准则。

enDef: one of three periods of equal length that the school year is divided into

example.en: At the end of the first trimester, the fetus is about three inches long.
example.cn: 在怀孕的第三个月末，胎儿差不多有三英寸长了。

enDef: the upper level of soil in which most plants have their roots

example.en: The topsoil has been almost completely washed away.
example.cn: 表层土壤已差不多完全给冲走了。

enDef: a small piece of paper, cloth, plastic etc that sticks out from the edge of something, so that you can find it more easily

example.en: an index tab labeled ‘Expenses’
example.cn: 标着“支出”字样的检索标签
